d:
Bangladesh's Tarique Rahman-led government has frozen financial allocations to local bodies in Gopalganj, the home district of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, following violent protests by Awami League supporters. Train services remain suspended, while two police stations are yet to reopen. With Hasina announcing plans to return to Bangladesh on December 16, tensions are rising. Is the government using economic and administrative pressure to contain the unrest?
Production: Akankshya
Video Editor: Nitin
